DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

The chest X-ray showing fine reticular granulation with a ground-glass appearance is characteristic of alveolar collapse and hyaline membrane formation in a preterm infant. This radiographic finding, combined with the clinical picture of respiratory distress, strongly supports a diagnosis of RDS rather than transient tachypnea of the newborn.
